SHARED-F-2-S80.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S80.description: Expose consent capture, tier escalation, and consent status retrieval via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration. Ensure Pydantic validation, safe defaults (Tier 1), and compatibility with chat tool-use patterns.

SHARED-F-2-S81.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
SHARED-F-2-S81.description: Integrate consent framework with lead capture and unknown question services to enforce Tier 2 requirement before storing identifiable data and ensure de-identified handling otherwise. Validate end-to-end workflow across services.
